title: AI-Native Task-Oriented Semantic Communications over a Relay: Benefits and Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.08155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communication (SemCom) using a relay node is considered, where the relay assists in conveying task-relevant information from a source to a destination, with meaning defined by classification labels. A joint end-to-end design of the source encoder, relay transformation, and destination decoders is developed to optimize both semantic inference accuracy and perceptual reconstruction quality for image data. Relay-assisted schemes are shown to outperform direct transmission, with gains that become more pronounced in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regimes across different relaying strategies. Alongside these performance benefits, however, a key security vulnerability introduced by the relay is identified, and a Byzantine attack is formulated in which the relay injects structured, learned perturbations into its transmitted signal. translated_title: 基于中继的AI原生面向任务语义通信：收益与脆弱性
translated_abstract: 本文考虑了使用中继节点的语义通信（SemCom）场景，其中中继协助将任务相关信息从源节点传递至目的节点，其语义含义由分类标签定义。研究开发了源编码器、中继变换和目的端解码器的联合端到端设计，以同时优化图像数据的语义推理精度和感知重建质量。结果表明，中继辅助方案优于直接传输，并且在不同的中继策略下，这种增益在低信噪比（SNR）环境中表现得更为显著。然而，与这些性能收益并存的是，研究识别出中继引入的一个关键安全漏洞，并形式化了一种拜占庭攻击：中继在其发送信号中注入结构化的、通过学习得到的扰动。该攻击作用于受信道效应影响的中间通信表示，其扰……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了基于中继的任务导向语义通信的联合端到端设计，证明其在低信噪比下优于直接传输，同时首次揭示并形式化了中继注入学习扰动的拜占庭攻击这一关键安全漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a joint end-to-end design for AI-native task-oriented semantic communication over a relay, demonstrating performance gains over direct transmission especially at low SNR, while identifying and formulating a Byzantine attack in which the relay injects structured, learned perturbations, revealing a key security vulnerability.
